title: Maximum iteration steps
overview: Sets the outer-iteration limit used by SimuIterState::Running when iexitflag is zero. Iteration::Init reads maxSteps and copies it to maxIterSteps. When iexitflag is nonzero, the running condition is based on currTime and maxTime instead; maxSteps is not the active stop condition in that branch.
principle: maxSteps is an iteration-count limit, not a physical time limit or a convergence criterion. The stop condition is selected by iexitflag: the iteration-count branch compares outerSteps with maxSteps, while the time-controlled branch compares currTime with maxTime.
architecture: Iteration::Init loads maxSteps into the shared Iteration state. SimuIterState::Running evaluates the stop condition using ctrl.iexitflag. This contract records the current outer-loop stop behavior and does not infer residual convergence or inner-iteration limits.

proves: Iteration::Init reads maxSteps as an integer and assigns the value to Iteration::maxIterSteps.
When ctrl.iexitflag is zero, SimuIterState::Running stops when Iteration::outerSteps is greater than or equal to Iteration::maxSteps.
When ctrl.iexitflag is nonzero, SimuIterState::Running uses ctrl.currTime and ctrl.maxTime instead of maxSteps.
does_not_prove: That maxSteps is a residual-convergence criterion.
That maxSteps controls inner iterations or every solver-specific sub-iteration.
An admissible range, positivity check, or defaulting policy for the input parameter.
That a run reaches a converged or physically accurate solution before the configured stop condition.

verification.scope: Source-backed parameter read and outer-loop stop-condition branches; no test execution or convergence claim is implied.
